prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `DirectoryEntry` and class `DirectoryIndex`. An entry contains string `id`, `label`, and readonly string array `keywords`. The constructor accepts readonly entries, rejects blank IDs or labels, duplicate IDs, malformed keywords, and malformed arrays with `TypeError`, and stores defensive copies. `get(id)` returns a fresh copy or null. `search(text, limit)` trims and lowercases the query, splits it on one-or-more whitespace characters, and returns entries whose label-and-keyword combined text contains every token. Empty search text matches all entries. Results are sorted by label using ordinary code-unit comparison, then by ID, and truncated to `limit`. Limit must be a nonnegative safe integer; zero returns an empty array. Returned entries and keyword arrays must be fresh copies. Inputs must never be mutated.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
